        ### Question
        Which of the following semi-solid pharmaceutical forms with which a master formula can be prepared has greater occlusivity ?:

opb. Hydrophobic or water-oily creams.
opc. Hydrophilic or ole-aqueous creams.
opd. Hydrophilic ointments

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
CHAIN: "Hydrophobic ointments" -> "high lipid content" -> "forms barrier on skin" -> "prevents water loss" -> "greater occlusivity" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Hydrophobic or water-oily creams" -> "moderate lipid content" -> "partial barrier on skin" -> "some water loss prevention" -> "moderate occlusivity" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Hydrophilic or ole-aqueous creams" -> "low lipid content" -> "minimal barrier on skin" -> "limited water loss prevention" -> "low occlusivity" -> 60%
CHAIN: "Hydrophilic ointments" -> "water-based" -> "no barrier on skin" -> "no water loss prevention" -> "minimal occlusivity" -> 50%
